title: Inside the Round Bedroom of a Rock Lighthouse
asof: History from National Records of Scotland · full video on the channel

shots.s: Three men slept in this round room, in the middle of the sea.
This is the Bell Rock Lighthouse, off Scotland, finished in 1810.
The bedroom is about thirteen feet across.
Three bunks, curved to fit the wall.
They slept between night watches, winding the lamp's clockwork every thirty minutes.
Fresh water was rationed, so there was no shower or bath.
The rock didn't get a toilet until 1964.
And outside, the sea hammered the tower.
Could you sleep there for a month?
